title: Zesty Crunchy Malaysian Vegetable Satay
description: A cultured and energizing Malaysian dish featuring a mix of sauteed vegetables and salsa, served with crunchy satay, this recipe is perfect for a quick and healthy meal. It is a satvik-friendly dish, meaning it is free from animal products and by-products.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and onions

instructions: Heat the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender-crisp.
Add the firm tofu and cook until it is golden brown.
Stir in the salsa and satay sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Transfer the vegetable mixture to a serving platter.
Garnish with crunchy rice cereal and chopped cilantro.
